market.what: Rare-earth oxide recovered from NdFeB magnet scrap, world (mostly China swarf)
market.method: est. ~28 kt REO/yr (330 kt magnets, ~25-30% scrap, ~30% REO; Huahong alone 8.8 kt) x $68/kg recycled PrNd (SMM, Jun 2025)
market.job_what: leach + solvent-extraction processing of NdFeB magnet scrap into separated REO, world (mostly China)
market.job_method: est.: ~28 kt REO/yr from scrap x ~$20/kg processing (SX >$10/kg; magnet-feed toll $25-35/kg ReElement) = ~$0.56B; low confidence

value.logic: Nd/Dy-selective pull straight from Fe-rich leach: +5% REO recovery ($3.4/kg) + skip Fe-removal step (~$4/kg est.) = ~$7.5/kg REO. x est. 8 kt REO/yr ex-China scrap by 2032 = $60M/yr ($210M if China counted)
value.revenue_logic: 30% of ex-China scrap REO (2.4 kt) x $2/kg extractant + licence
value.margin_logic: simple 1-2 step amide, toll-made cheaply; licence share high

trend.drivers: magnet recycling 2.8x by 2031 (IDTechEx); China Dy/Tb export controls Apr 2025; EU CRMA 25% recycling benchmark 2030; EV/robot motors

competition.paper_query: NdFeB magnet scrap rare earth recovery
competition.notes: TODGA is not the industrial choice; China swarf recycling is large (Huahong 8.8 kt REO 2025, +71%); end-of-life magnets <1% recycled. Carester EUR216M (Lacq, 2026); Cyclic $55M Series B (2025); Ionic $14.8M APC grant (2025).

lab.synth: 1-2 step custom: alkoxyacetamide from alkoxyacetic acid + dipropylamine; 3 variants
lab.test: Leach real NdFeB swarf; batch D for Nd, Pr, Dy, Fe, Co, B vs TODGA and P507; ICP-OES at a university lab
lab.logic: synth 5 wk, 3 x ~$5k = $15k (China CRO) + test 4 wk: scrap ~$0.5k, ~150 ICP-OES x $35-50 = ~$7k, misc ~$2.5k

sale.gates: bench + pilot run at a recycler (Ionic/Cyclic/Carester scale) 6-12 mo; oxide spec accepted by magnet maker 6-12 mo
